description: Shared shape for both window.FAQ_ITEMS (a repo's own site/data/faq.js) and window.FAQ_ITEMS_COMMON (kit's site/data/common-faq.js) -- a consuming repo's faq.js spreads FAQ_ITEMS_COMMON into its own array at runtime ([...own items, ...window.FAQ_ITEMS_COMMON]); that spread is a JS-runtime detail, not a schema concern -- each array validates independently against this same schema.

id.description: Stable, hand-picked kebab-case slug -- becomes the #faq-<id> pilcrow anchor. Never derive it from `q`, or existing links break when questions are reworded/reordered.

a.description: One array item per rendered paragraph. FAQ.dc.html's own paragraph mapper doesn't render `{strong}` even though the shared Paragraph/ConfigPart type allows it -- avoid strong runs here.
